items.q: Does Primeagen think we should pack the office because agents write code?
items.a: **No.** He suspects it is **neither** 'API access decides quality' **nor** business as usual. Agents are **officially good**. Treating them as idiots is foolish. Programming did not end.

items.q: Who gets fired first in the agent era?
items.a: The person who **only directs an AI to figure everything out** — same profile as the old **Stack Overflow copy-paster** who never learned the system. Faster copy machine. You add nothing.

items.q: Why does Primeagen say 'they had an oracle' is not a dunk on Bun?
items.a: It is **why it worked**. Years of tests plus a **formal spec** ('code that said this is how you should operate'). Give agents that plus direction and they refine until it works. Most products do not have that.

items.q: What earlier Anthropic project does he pair with the Bun rewrite?
items.a: A **C compiler** from parallel Claude / Opus 4.6. Same condition: **30 years of tests**, hard-won knowledge, and **GCC already in the weights**. Regurgitate + harness, not greenfield invention.

items.q: Why hasn't EVE Online just LLM-ported Python 2 to 3 like Bun?
items.a: Same source **compiles in both** and **behaves differently** (`1/2` is `0` vs `0.5`). They already use agents on a 30-year poorly documented codebase. Primeagen: the **verification system is another order of magnitude**, so humans stay in the loop.

items.q: What happened when the LLM told Linus the graphics-driver bug was impossible?
items.a: He kept going: **24 debug patches**, **18 kernel boots**, then a **one-line** fix. Same-access agents, different human. Fable also found a leak in Primeagen's game and **refused to say where** ('hacking').

items.q: What happened to the return on reading the manual?
items.a: Curiosity and RTFM used to pay about **3%**. Primeagen: now about **10%**. He is **more bullish on learning than ever**. Stop being a paste proxy. Ask questions.

items.q: Did everyone vibe-code video games with Gemini 3 Flash by the end of 2025?
items.a: **No.** That was his 'sure-fire' joke. Demos are still crappy. No 3D-game knowledge → **no magic 3D game**. Floor rose; ceiling did not vanish.
